tasks.title: Connect visual generation and animation pipeline
tasks.task: Connect approved visual generation providers and complete a verified owner-approved multi-shot production render.
tasks.goal: Connect ComfyUI/approved compute adapters for repeatable character-consistent image/video generation with cost and approval gates.
tasks.result: Localhost-only ComfyUI adapter, deterministic render-job planner, persistent render manifest DB, API-workflow placeholder contract, health/node inventory, owner+execution dual gate, and private dry-run manifest for all STUDIO-004 shots. Provider upgrade: AHOS now has a guarded RunPod Serverless LTX-2 adapter, atomic inline-output materialization with decoded byte-size and SHA-256 verification, and a persistent planned/submitted/completed/failed state machine that permits controlled retry after failure but rejects invalid transitions. RunPod paid execution requires owner_approved + execution_enabled + paid_provider_enabled simultaneously; secrets remain environment-only. Preview render default is 1024x576 (exact 16:9; both dimensions divisible by 32). No paid render was submitted during installation. Remaining work: run and validate a real complete multi-shot episode render before this stage can be called complete.

tasks.title: Build voice, music, dubbing and localization pipeline
tasks.task: Produce character-consistent speech, music and SFX, subtitles, and professional seven-language localized episode variants.
tasks.goal: Generate character-consistent speech, music/SFX, subtitles, and multi-language localized episode variants.
tasks.result: Kokoro English baseline, Chatterbox Multilingual V3 Turkish synthesis, Chatterbox reference-audio voice continuity, Kurmanji TTS, and OpenVoice V2 identity transfer are live-verified. The production path keeps infant vocalizations outside sentence TTS, applies age/gender/role voice policy, preserves per-character identity, validates approved WAV references, deterministically extends short OpenVoice references using only their own samples, rejects unusable returned audio before saving, and records machine-readable quality evidence. AHOS includes guarded paid-execution adapters, persistent per-character/per-language voice continuity, localization review/terminology memory, deterministic audio post-production planning, child-voice protection, mix targets, seven-language packaging, professional music/SFX supervision, canonical voice readiness auditing, and rendered-WAV QA. Secrets remain environment-only and paid retries remain behind owner/execution/provider gates. Remaining STUDIO-006 work: owner listening approval and canonical enrollment for every cast voice/language, actual music/SFX production, and final seven-language audio rendering.

tasks.title: Build episode assembly and studio QA pipeline
tasks.task: Assemble verified media into finished multilingual episodes and enforce professional release QA.
tasks.goal: Assemble scenes into finished episodes and enforce continuity, child-safety, audio, subtitle, technical, and release-package QA.
tasks.result: Deterministic episode assembly with graph-ordered picture concatenation and real local FFmpeg/FFprobe execution. The professional assembler verifies every source SHA-256 from file bytes, requires exactly one final mix and subtitle track per requested language, records stream language metadata, probes the finished Matroska master, enforces duration and stream-count tolerances, and emits content-addressed assembly evidence. Continuity, child-safety, picture, audio, subtitle, and technical QA remain fail-closed. Installation performs no paid API calls, publishing, or external actions. Remaining work: execute the complete seven-language acceptance episode with owner-reviewed production assets and bind its final evidence to a signed release manifest.
